text:
Would you walk 12 minutes to save ¥9,474? 🧳

We priced the same three nights on both sides of Osaka Station, then walked the route on the map.

Dates: Mon 14 – Thu 17 Dec 2026, 1 adult, Booking.com, checked 23 Nov.

━━━━━━━━━━
💰 THE PRICES
━━━━━━━━━━

🏨 Hotel Monterey Osaka, about 400 m from Osaka Station: ¥34,394 for 3 nights

🌿 Quintessa Hotel Osaka Umeda, about 400 m from Nakazakicho Station, double room, rated 8.5: ¥24,920 for 3 nights

That's about ¥3,160 a night less, or ¥9,474 over the stay.

━━━━━━━━━━
🚶 THE CATCH
━━━━━━━━━━

It's about 800 m, roughly 12 minutes on foot, from Osaka Station.

Add a few minutes to get from your platform out to the street. Osaka Station is big.

Don't want to walk? Nakazakicho is one stop from Higashi-Umeda on the Tanimachi subway line.

━━━━━━━━━━
✅ OUR TAKE
━━━━━━━━━━

👜 Small bag
Walk it. You'll be walking to Umeda most days anyway.

🧳 Heavy suitcase
Still book Nakazakicho, and take a taxi on arrival and departure. Osaka taxis start at ¥600 for the first 1.2 km, the ride is about 6 minutes, so expect roughly ¥600–800 each way. You still keep around ¥7,900.

🚄 Early trains most mornings
Then a hotel on top of the station is worth it. Hotel Granvia Osaka is about 100 m from the platforms, but it was ¥49,243 for the same three nights.

One rule of thumb: if the gap on your dates drops below about ¥500 a night, the two taxis cancel out the saving. Book in Umeda.

Full price check, route and taxi fares 👉 https://japanbystation.com/nakazakicho-vs-umeda-hotel

Walk, taxi, or pay for the station hotel? 👇
